items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; character screen-centered, world scrolls; speed ≈75–80px/s (1.5s ≈115–120px, 0.3s ≈25px). Space = Do Action (contextual pick/examine). LMB = Primary, RMB = Secondary. F = Do Attack (effect on mobs still untested). Esc = Pause menu (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save and Quit); pausing halts clock. Tab = Map (untested). Caps Lock = Open Crafting per Controls page 3, but Caps Lock could not be sent as an input this session—had to use the mouse on sidebar icons; keyboard craft panel still untested. '1' = Inv 1. Q/E rotate camera; scroll zooms. Controls pages advance with right arrow.

HOVER/PICK (observed): hovering shows verb labels ('Pick Flower/Grass/Sapling/Berry Bush', 'Examine …') even at 200–300px, so use hover to scout before walking. Picking requires ~100–130px; ~150px borderline/fails; >150px fails. Standing on a target flips Pick→Examine; step off and retry. Hotbar updates lag: successful picks appeared a slot later, so don't conclude failure from immediate hotbar state. Hotbar tooltips almost never render (counts/names usually unreadable) — one earlier hover did show 'Twigs'.

YIELDS (observed): yellow and red flowers→Petals; grass tuft→Cut Grass x1; leafy sapling→Twigs x1; berry bush→Berries x1. Each pick gave 1 item.

IDENTIFICATION (observed, corrections): bright tall yellow-green spiky plants = grass tufts ('Pick Grass'), not saplings. Leafy saplings with broad leaf clumps on thin stems give Twigs. IMPORTANT: some bare/bent twiggy sprigs are still harvestable ('Pick Sapling'), so not all twiggy plants are depleted—hover to distinguish. Flat bent twig sprites lying on open ground read 'Examine Sapling' = depleted. Harvested grass becomes a stub ('Examine Grass'); harvested saplings become bare branching twigs; plucked berry bushes look pale/spiky but can still look bright. Pine needles and trunks both read 'Examine Evergreen' and mimic yellow-green tufts. Sprigs/button bushes/bare branches = no verb, inert. Don't assume bright = available.

CRAFT UI (observed repeatedly): flame/Light sidebar icon at x≈0.019–0.022, Tools at y≈0.10–0.145, Light at y≈0.17–0.20; clicking a sidebar icon switches category. Categories shown: Tools (pickaxe/axe bright/craftable, other tiles locked with padlocks) and Light (campfire-, firepit-, torch-like dark silhouettes plus bright end-cap tiles). Hovering dark tiles gives no tooltip or highlight; left-clicking them produces no detail panel and no crafting effect (silent failure). Craft UI open does NOT pause time. Hypothesis (unverified): dark silhouettes indicate insufficient materials or locked recipes, and a recipe becomes bright/clickable when affordable; bright top/bottom tiles are decorative end-caps. Assumed unverified costs: Torch 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs; Campfire 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit rocks + unknown. Whether the recipe column scrolls is unknown.

NIGHT (observed): dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' then 'It's so dark!' with repeated 'OW! Something hit me!' / 'What was that?!' and red damage vignette until death; screen goes near-black, hard to act. A blue moon icon appears beside the Day clock at night (function unknown). Night fell on Day 1 itself and arrived quickly; being without light means death. Opening/using the craft panel after dark wasted the remaining time and did not save the character. Earlier a lit torch held through daylight let a prior attempt survive Night 1.

HUNGER (observed): 'I'm so hungry!' warning appears; Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Whether eating restores hunger is untested.

TERRAIN/NAVIGATION (observed): start = open burrow-heavy brown ground with rabbit holes, flowers, red mushrooms, butterflies, birds, sparse saplings, scattered pines with grass tufts at trunk bases (many depleted). Long east/southeast runs = burrow savanna, no grass field; southeast savanna had fresh leafy saplings. Dense pine grove west/southwest with plentiful grass and many bare depleted saplings. A richer cluster field (several grass tufts, a sapling, red and yellow flowers) was found after long travel west/southwest—best harvesting area. Red birds roam, including one very large red bird; hostility unknown, avoid.

FAILED/WASTEFUL (observed): repeated clicking of silhouette recipe tiles; hovering craft tiles/hotbar for tooltips; long walks toward distant labeled targets already known to be out of range; standing on pickables; treating all twiggy plants as depleted (and vice versa); assuming flat twig sprites are pickable; starting crafting at/after dusk; trusting immediate hotbar updates.

LESSONS/HYPOTHESES (unverified): daylight is a hard deadline—gather ≥2 Cut Grass (ideally 3+) and ≥2 Twigs immediately, then open the Light category and craft a torch by early/mid afternoon while visibility allows debugging the UI. Use hover-label scouting to choose nearby targets first. Berry bushes for food; test eating petals/berries when hunger warns. Locked padlock recipes likely need a Science Machine. Open questions: blue moon icon; eating mechanics; F attack utility; whether craft column scrolls; whether a campfire/fire pit is cheaper than a torch; science machine availability; whether tooltips can ever be made to render.
